summary: Regression test for recent UI edits (inline canvas '+ Add line item' button, enlarged totals, tightened spacing). Backend regression suite ran green (23/23). Frontend editor flows all verified: canvas-add-line-item adds a new editable row (rows 8 -> 10 on INV-0009), live Subtotal/Total updates correctly on qty*rate change (₹9,500 -> ₹10,250 after adding qty=3, rate=250 line), Save persists after reload, Share and toolbar Line item / Export / Save buttons all present, and Export menu renders PDF·A4 / PDF·US Letter / Word·DOCX. Backend PDF (A4 & Letter) and DOCX endpoints all return valid file signatures. Indian currency grouping (₹10,250.00) works with INR selected.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentCanvas uses contentEditable td cells for qty/rate rather than <input>; works but adds no data-testid per row. Fine for now, but for more granular Playwright targeting consider adding data-testid on each qty/rate cell (e.g. data-testid=line-qty-{idx}).
canvas-add-line-item pushes a row with rate=0 and description 'New service' — matches expectation; recalc via onInput on <table> fires and updates totals correctly.
seed_data_creation: Modified existing invoice 6abd021db8793838a7a920f7 (INV-0009): added 2 new rows via canvas-add-line-item, filled qty=3 rate=250 on last, saved. Total now ₹10,250.00. Prior TEST_ClientA / test docs from iteration 1 still in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Existing invoices with line items available (INV-0001..INV-0009). Editor route is /documents/{id}. Canvas rows use contentEditable td.qty / td.rate cells (no per-row data-testid). Toolbar buttons: add-line-item-button, save-document-button, share-button, currency-select. Export menu: export-pdf-a4, export-pdf-letter, export-docx. Backend regression: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v.
